preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and stdin.islower() and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and (len(line.split()[1]) <= 10 or ('...' in line.split()[1] and len(line.split()[1]) == 9)) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
postconditions.description: Each non-empty line of stdout is formatted as 'length answer', where 'length' is an integer and 'answer' is either the full string (if length ≤ 10) or a truncated version (first 5 chars + '...' + last 2 chars if length > 10).

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == len(stdin) and all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[0]) == len(stdin[i:]) - sum(1 for j in range(i, len(stdin)-1) if stdin[j] == stdin[j+1] and not any(i <= k < j or j < k <= j+1 for k in selected_pairs)) for i in range(len(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each suffix starting at index i (0-based), the output line corresponds to the lexicographically smallest string obtained by removing all characters in selected pairs (i, i+1) where s[i] == s[i+1] and no index is in more than one pair. The length of the output string is the length of the suffix minus the number of removed characters.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[1] == lex_smallest_suffix(stdin[i:])) for i in range(len(stdin)))
postconditions.description: The output string for each suffix is the lexicographically smallest possible string after removing valid pairs, where lex_smallest_suffix(s) is defined as the result of greedily removing adjacent duplicate pairs to minimize the string lexicographically.
